datasets.name: mitbih-original-212
datasets.description: Original packed ECG records 100 and 101 concatenated in order, no sample conversion.

datasets.name: mitbih-s16le
datasets.description: Same records unpacked losslessly from WFDB 212 to interleaved signed 16-bit little-endian samples. Exact 212 repacking verified. Conversion is outside compression timing.

datasets.name: eeg-edf-original
datasets.description: Four complete original EDF+ files S001R03 through S004R03 concatenated in order, including headers and annotation channels. No conversion, scaling, duplication or quantization.

datasets.name: ptb-12lead-original
datasets.description: Original 12-channel signed 16-bit little-endian ECG .dat file; 12-channel stride is deliberately outside the original codec candidate set. No conversion.

datasets.name: terrain-hgt-be
datasets.description: Complete N37W122 elevation tile, gzip transport removed. Original big-endian signed 16-bit HGT samples.

datasets.name: terrain-s16le
datasets.description: Same complete elevation tile with reversible byte swap to little endian, no quantization. Byte-swap conversion is outside compression timing.

datasets.name: synthetic-u32be-12ch
datasets.description: Synthetic big-endian 32-bit, 12 interleaved channels, wrapping counters plus deterministic small noise; 2 MiB.

datasets.name: synthetic-u64le-3ch
datasets.description: Synthetic little-endian 64-bit, three interleaved counters above 2^53, with wrapping and small deterministic noise; 2 MiB.

datasets.name: synthetic-f64be-3ch
datasets.description: Synthetic big-endian binary64, three channels, exactly represented increments plus sparse NaN payloads, signed zero and infinities; 2 MiB. No floating point arithmetic in codec.
